A low-poly game scene based on this game design:
# Game design

Written from `bitmagic init --idea`. Keep it current as the game changes — `bitmagic cover` reads this file.

## Pitch

Nokia Bounce 3D is a physics-driven 3D platformer where players guide an iconic high-gloss red rubber sphere across floating island courses, leaping through golden hoop rings, bouncing high on yellow trampolines, dodging deadly hazard spikes, and speeding to the swirling exit portal.

## Core loop

- **Roll & Momentum**: Roll and steer the bouncy red sphere across floating platforms with responsive momentum physics.
- **Collect Golden Hoops**: Navigate jumping arcs and ramps to leap through 5 floating golden hoops, triggering melodic chimes.
- **Rubber Trampoline Launches**: Hit spring-loaded yellow bounce pads to gain massive vertical airtime to reach elevated ledges.
- **Hazard Navigation**: Dodge sharp red crystal spikes; collisions instantly pop the ball and trigger checkpoint respawns.
- **Exit Portal Speedrun**: Unlock the swirling dimensional portal once all 5 hoops are collected, completing the stage with a personal speedrun record.

## World & look

A sunny, cheerful arcade dreamscape of floating green island platforms with stone borders suspended in a bright turquoise sky with fluffy stylized low-poly clouds. Floating golden rings gleam with metallic specular highlights. Vibrant yellow trampolines with visible steel accordion springs. Red geometric crystal spikes warn of peril. A magical swirling cyan-magenta vortex portal marks the 

Depict the world and atmosphere as a single illustrated scene. Low-poly art with flat-shaded facets and hard edges on every object, no cubes, no voxels, rendered as a highly polished 3D scene with the craft of a Pixar-quality animated film, cinematic lighting that fits the scene, soft ambient occlusion, rich detail and expressive composition. Wordless illustration, no text, no title, no words, no letters, no logos, no UI.

assets.name: Skyward Hoop Run
assets.prompt: A polished low-poly third-person 3D platformer course matching the accepted reference: a broad grassy starting island with stone edging and an unobstructed path that climbs through connected floating grass-and-slate islands over a bright blue sky abyss. Build a clear, playable forward route with gentle ramps and wide landings, golden hoop collectibles placed directly on the safe route, yellow spring pads that visibly launch the player across gaps, red faceted crystal spike hazards placed beside rather than across the critical line, two clear checkpoint terraces, stylized conifer trees and floating rocks, and a large glowing cyan-magenta stone portal on the final highest island visible from earlier viewpoints. Use saturated emerald grass, faceted dark slate cliffs, gold hoops, bright blue sky and white low-poly clouds. Prioritize precise platform collision, forgiving landings and a continuous progression suitable for a rolling red ball.

features.name: GoldenPath
features.description: The single guaranteed route from spawn to goal (Skyhoop Ascent). Use for progression %, "next objective", camera look-ahead and ordered checkpoints. Segment kinds in order: run, jump, ride, run, ride, run, run, jump, run.

features.name: Challenge_0
features.description: Hop-chain crossing: the wall is too tall to jump (7.8m); the player climbs the platform chain on the approach side and drops beyond. The static stage is complete and completable — ADD hazard/flavor only (patrolling enemy, collectible on the top hop), do NOT add geometry. (Open structure: the stage can be walked around — it gates the DIRECT route; keep the mechanism rewarding, e.g. put a collectible on it.)

features.name: Challenge_1
features.description: Vertical elevator up an unjumpable wall, then a fixed bridge across. THE ENGINE BUILDS AND RUNS THE ELEVATOR AUTOMATICALLY (params.engineAutoBuild) — do NOT build it yourself. Your job is flavor: theme the shaft, add a hazard timed against the ride, a reward on the top ledge. Hazards/props must stay CLEAR of the elevator's vertical travel path — never place anything that intersects its ride volume. (Open structure: the stage can be walked around — it gates the DIRECT route; keep the mechanism rewarding, e.g. put a collectible on it.)

features.name: Challenge_2
features.description: Moving-platform ferry over an unjumpable wall. THE ENGINE BUILDS AND RUNS THE FERRY AUTOMATICALLY (params.engineAutoBuild) — do NOT build the platform yourself (a duplicate would double-carry). Your job is flavor: theme the site, add a hazard or patrolling enemy, a collectible on the crest. Hazards/props must stay CLEAR of the platform's swept travel path (the segment params.from→params.to, platform-sized) — never place anything that intersects it. (Open structure: the stage can be walked around — it gates the DIRECT route; keep the mechanism rewarding, e.g. put a collectible on it.)

features.name: Challenge_3
features.description: Spinner gauntlet: the only way through the thick wall is the central corridor, swept by rotating bar(s) that physically push the player — time the crossing. THE ENGINE BUILDS AND RUNS THE SPINNERS AUTOMATICALLY (params.engineAutoBuild) — do NOT build them yourself (a visual copy would double the hazard). Your job is flavor: theme the corridor walls, warning marks at the mouths, a sound tied to the hazard. Nothing may be placed inside the corridor. (Open structure: the stage can be walked around — it gates the DIRECT route; keep the mechanism rewarding, e.g. put a collectible on it.)

features.name: Challenge_4
features.description: Crumbling crossing: solid baked first/last hops; the hops between them break underfoot and respawn. THE ENGINE BUILDS AND RUNS THE CRUMBLING PLATFORMS AUTOMATICALLY (params.engineAutoBuild) — do NOT build them yourself. Your job is flavor: dust/particle feedback on break, a sound, a collectible risk-reward on a side hop. (Open structure: the stage can be walked around — it gates the DIRECT route; keep the mechanism rewarding, e.g. put a collectible on it.)

features.name: hz_crystals_meadow
features.description: Designer hazard zone: red crystal spikes besid, inside region "hoop_meadow" (points[0] = region center, params.radiusM = its radius). Build a visible, physically real red crystal spikes besid hazard there; on touch the player soft-recovers (lifted back to nearby safe ground). Keep the golden trail crossable. Moving parts should be world.json mechanisms[] entries.

features.name: hz_crystals_ridge
features.description: Designer hazard zone: red crystal spikes linin, inside region "crystal_ridge" (points[0] = region center, params.radiusM = its radius). Build a visible, physically real red crystal spikes linin hazard there; on touch the player soft-recovers (lifted back to nearby safe ground). Keep the golden trail crossable. Moving parts should be world.json mechanisms[] entries.

features.name: hz_abyss
features.description: Designer hazard zone: sky abyss fall, inside region "spring_reach" (points[0] = region center, params.radiusM = its radius). Build a visible, physically real sky abyss fall hazard there; on touch the player respawns at the last checkpoint. Keep the golden trail crossable. Moving parts should be world.json mechanisms[] entries.
